179288.name: hsp-16.49
179288.summary: Predicted to enable unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response; and response to heat. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cataract 9 multiple types. Orthologous to human CRYAA (crystallin alpha A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179319.name: gpa-3
179319.summary: Enables olfactory receptor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to cGMP; determination of adult lifespan; and regulation of gene expression. Located in axon; neuronal cell body; and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in AIZ; PVT; amphid neurons; and phasmid neurons. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179331.name: eif-2Bdelta
179331.description: Translation initiation factor eIF2B subunit delta
179331.otherdesignations: Translation initiation factor eIF2B subunit delta
179331.nomenclaturename: Translation initiation factor eIF2B subunit delta
179331.summary: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and translation initiation factor activity. Involved in cytoplasmic translational initiation. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in leukoencephalopathy with vanishing white matter 4. Orthologous to human EIF2B4 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2B subunit delta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179341.name: his-37
179341.summary: Predicted to enable DNA binding activity and protein heterodimerization activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of chromatin. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; innate immune response; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in chromosome and nucleus. Predicted to be part of nucleosome. Orthologous to several human genes including H4C1 (H4 clustered histone 1); H4C11 (H4 clustered histone 11); and H4C12 (H4 clustered histone 12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179412.name: egl-3
179412.summary: Enables FBXO family protein binding activity and serine-type endopeptidase activity. Involved in several processes, including modulation of chemical synaptic transmission; positive regulation of behavior; and protein processing. Located in axon. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; nervous system; pharynx; tail; and uv1. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in myocardial infarction and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human PCSK2 (proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179424.name: akt-1
179424.summary: Enables calmodulin binding activity; phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate binding activity; and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; insulin receptor signaling pathway; and intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in response to DNA damage by p53 class mediator. Located in axon; dendrite; and neuronal cell body. Is active in cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory canal; neurons; pharynx; rectal gland cell; and ventral nerve cord. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including breast cancer (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); glucose metabolism disease (multiple); pancreatic cancer (multiple); and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to human AKT1 (AKT serine/threonine kinase 1); AKT2 (AKT serine/threonine kinase 2); and AKT3 (AKT serine/threonine kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179427.name: ric-4
179427.summary: Predicted to enable SNAP receptor activity. Involved in cholinergic synaptic transmission. Located in plasma membrane and synapse. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory gland cell; intestinal cell; nervous system; pharyngeal gland cell; and rectal gland cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Down syndrome and congenital myasthenic syndrome 18. Orthologous to several human genes including SNAP23 (synaptosome associated protein 23). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179432.name: B0024.4
179432.summary: Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium. Located in membrane raft. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179461.name: egl-9
179461.summary: Enables peptidyl-proline 4-dioxygenase activity. Involved in response to hypoxia. Located in dendrite and nucleus. Is expressed in ventral nerve cord and vulval precursor cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial erythrocytosis 3; polycythemia; and renal cell carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including EGLN1 (egl-9 family hypoxia inducible factor 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179475.name: mics-1
179475.summary: Predicted to be located in membrane. Orthologous to human SYNJ2BP (synaptojanin 2 binding protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179477.name: lpd-9
179477.summary: Involved in lipid storage. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179499.name: prp-38
179499.summary: Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of precatalytic spliceosome. Orthologous to human PRPF38A (pre-mRNA processing factor 38A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179503.name: nrx-1
179503.summary: Predicted to enable neuroligin family protein binding activity and transmembrane signaling receptor activity. Involved in negative regulation of receptor clustering. Located in presynaptic active zone. Is expressed in GABAergic neurons; cholinergic neurons; nervous system; neurons; and ventral cord neurons. Used to study autism spectrum disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Pitt-Hopkins-like syndrome 2; alcohol dependence; and nicotine dependence. Orthologous to human NRXN1 (neurexin 1); NRXN2 (neurexin 2); and NRXN3 (neurexin 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179520.name: vps-36
179520.summary: Predicted to enable ubiquitin binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein transport to vacuole involved in ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the multivesicular body sorting pathway. Predicted to be located in endosome. Predicted to be part of ESCRT II complex. Predicted to be active in late endosome membrane. Is expressed in body wall musculature; nervous system; non-striated muscle; and reproductive system. Orthologous to human VPS36 (vacuolar protein sorting 36 homolog). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179541.name: atp-5
179541.summary: Predicted to enable proton transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Predicted to be part of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Orthologous to human ATP5PD (ATP synthase peripheral stalk subunit d). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179546.name: gpa-1
179546.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be part of heterotrimeric G-protein complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including SPD; chemosensory neurons; head mesodermal cell; pharyngeal neurons; and postcloacal sensillum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179551.name: T19B10.2
179551.summary: Is expressed in hypodermis. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179572.name: cnb-1
179572.description: EF-hand domain-containing protein;Protein phosphatase 2B regulatory subunit cnb-1
179572.otherdesignations: EF-hand domain-containing protein;Protein phosphatase 2B regulatory subunit cnb-1
179572.nomenclaturename: EF-hand domain-containing protein;Protein phosphatase 2B regulatory subunit cnb-1
179572.summary: Enables calcium ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in calcineurin-mediated signaling. Located in endoplasmic reticulum; sarcomere; and striated muscle dense body. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease and dilated cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP3R1 (protein phosphatase 3 regulatory subunit B, alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179574.name: des-2
179574.description: Acetylcholine receptor DES-2-like protein;Acetylcholine receptor subunit alpha-type des-2
179574.otherdesignations: Acetylcholine receptor DES-2-like protein;Acetylcholine receptor subunit alpha-type des-2
179574.nomenclaturename: Acetylcholine receptor DES-2-like protein;Acetylcholine receptor subunit alpha-type des-2
179574.summary: Predicted to enable neurotransmitter receptor activity. Predicted to contribute to acetylcholine-gated monoatomic cation-selective channel activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including calcium ion transport; cholinergic synaptic transmission; and regulation of membrane potential. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in head neurons; interneuron; and pm1. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179592.name: sas-5
179592.summary: Involved in centriole replication. Located in centriole and cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179616.name: pyc-1
179616.summary: Predicted to enable pyruvate carboxylase activity. Predicted to be involved in gluconeogenesis. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pyruvate carboxylase deficiency disease. Orthologous to human PC (pyruvate carboxylase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179631.name: osm-6
179631.description: Intraflagellar transport protein 52 C-terminal domain-containing protein
179631.otherdesignations: Intraflagellar transport protein 52 C-terminal domain-containing protein
179631.nomenclaturename: Intraflagellar transport protein 52 C-terminal domain-containing protein
179631.summary: Involved in several processes, including cellular response to salt; non-motile cilium assembly; and sensory perception of mechanical stimulus. Located in several cellular components, including ciliary basal body; ciliary transition zone; and neuronal cell body. Is expressed in neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in asphyxiating thoracic dystrophy. Orthologous to human IFT52 (intraflagellar transport 52). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179641.name: rpt-1
179641.summary: Predicted to enable proteasome-activating activity. Predicted to be involved in proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Predicted to be part of proteasome regulatory particle, base subcomplex. Orthologous to human PSMC2 (proteasome 26S subunit, ATPase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179666.name: che-11
179666.summary: Involved in several processes, including dauer entry; determination of adult lifespan; and positive regulation of intracellular transport. Located in non-motile cilium. Is expressed in body wall musculature; head; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 80 and short-rib thoracic dysplasia 9 with or without polydactyly. Orthologous to human IFT140 (intraflagellar transport 140). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179707.name: egl-10
179707.summary: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Involved in several processes, including G protein-coupled dopamine receptor signaling pathway; regulation of egg-laying behavior; and rhythmic behavior. Located in cytoplasm and neuron projection. Is expressed in body wall musculature and neurons. Used to study depressive disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alcohol dependence. Orthologous to human RGS6 (regulator of G protein signaling 6) and RGS7 (regulator of G protein signaling 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179721.name: mrps-5
179721.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane and ribosome. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPS5 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179725.name: ril-2
179725.summary: Predicted to be involved in several processes, including Golgi to lysosome transport; lysosomal lumen pH elevation; and vesicle transport along microtubule. Predicted to be located in several cellular components, including cytosol; endomembrane system; and vacuole. Predicted to be active in Golgi apparatus; late endosome; and lysosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179731.name: gpa-8
179731.summary: Predicted to enable G protein-coupled receptor binding activity; G-protein beta/gamma-subunit complex binding activity; and GTPase activity. Predicted to be involved in adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be part of heterotrimeric G-protein complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in head and nervous system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179741.name: dhs-21
179741.summary: Enables L-xylulose reductase (NADPH) activity and carbonyl reductase (NADPH) activity. Involved in xylulose catabolic process. Located in plasma membrane. Is expressed in hermaphrodite gonad; hypodermis; and intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pentosuria. Orthologous to human DCXR (dicarbonyl and L-xylulose reductase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179779.name: eif-3.K
179779.description: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit K
179779.otherdesignations: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit K
179779.nomenclaturename: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit K
179779.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and ribosome binding activity. Predicted to contribute to translation initiation factor activity. Involved in positive regulation of apoptotic process. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including embryonic cell and germ line. Orthologous to human EIF3K (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit K). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

179794.name: max-1
179794.summary: Involved in motor neuron axon guidance. Predicted to be located in cytoskeleton. Is expressed in neurons. Orthologous to human PLEKHH1 (pleckstrin homology, MyTH4 and FERM domain containing H1) and PLEKHH2 (pleckstrin homology, MyTH4 and FERM domain containing H2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179796.name: eat-6
179796.summary: Enables P-type sodium:potassium-exchanging transporter activity. Involved in several processes, including action potential; establishment or maintenance of transmembrane electrochemical gradient; and metal ion transport. Located in membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including coelomocyte; intestine; neurons; pharynx; and vulval muscle. Used to study alcohol use disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2DD; alternating hemiplegia of childhood; bipolar disorder; brain disease (multiple); and hypertension. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP1A3 (ATPase Na+/K+ transporting subunit alpha 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179806.name: odr-3
179806.summary: Enables olfactory receptor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including hyperosmotic response; olfactory behavior; and response to odorant. Located in neuronal cell body and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in nervous system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

179849.name: F53F4.11
179849.summary: Orthologous to human RSL1D1 (ribosomal L1 domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
